setup.discord: Click Connect and a Discord login window opens. Scan the QR with the Discord app on your phone, or log in with your email and password. AbacusAIBot then messages as your own Discord account — no bot, no token. Or link the Abacus AI bot below and DM it from anywhere.
setup.telegram: Click Connect and a Telegram login window opens. Log in there the way you already do — scan the QR with your phone (Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device), or use your phone number or a passkey. AbacusAIBot then messages as your own Telegram account. No API keys, no bot.
setup.whatsapp: Enable this, then scan the QR code below from WhatsApp on your phone (Settings, Linked devices, Link a device). This links AbacusAIBot as a device on that account, so use a dedicated number rather than your personal one.

messaging.telegramConnected: Connected — the agent reads your chats and messages other people as your Telegram account; messages to you arrive from your AbacusAI Bot.
messaging.telegramScan: A Telegram login window opened — scan its QR with your phone (Settings, Devices, Add Device), or log in there by phone.
messaging.twoStepSetup: Two steps, and you need both: sign in to {{app}}, then link the Abacus AI bot so you can reach your agent from any device. Setup is not finished until both are done.
messaging.whatsappConnected: Connected — message me from your “Message yourself” chat in WhatsApp. The agent also messages people as your account.
messaging.whatsappScan: Open WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan the code above. Once linked, message me from your “Message yourself” chat.
messaging.whatsappSyncing: Linked — WhatsApp is syncing your chats to this device. This takes a few minutes the first time. Keep WhatsApp open on your phone and keep this app open until it finishes.

connectors.body: Connect the tools you already use. Sign in with a free Abacus.AI account to add built-in connectors in one click.

memory.body: What the agent carries between sessions, and the standing instructions it follows. Read it, edit it, and delete whatever has gone stale.
